<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1921407_nowflix.ReviewFilterUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ReviewFilterUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var ReviewFilterUtils = Class.create();
ReviewFilterUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    getEligibleMedia: function() {
        var userId = gs.getUserID();
        var reviewedMedia = [];

        // 1. Buscar reviews que o usuário logado já fez
        var grReview = new GlideRecord('x_1921407_nowflix_review');
        grReview.addQuery('user', userId); // Certifique-se que o campo de usuário na tabela chama u_user
        grReview.addQuery('state', '!=', 'reproved'); // Ignora as reprovadas
        grReview.query();

        while (grReview.next()) {
            reviewedMedia.push(grReview.getValue('media')); // Pega o ID do filme já avaliado
        }

        // 2. Retorna o filtro para a variável 'Media' do Record Producer
        if (reviewedMedia.length > 0) {
            // "Me mostre apenas filmes cujo sys_id NÃO esteja na lista de avaliados"
            return 'sys_idNOT IN' + reviewedMedia.join(',');
        }

        return ''; // Se não tiver feito review nenhuma, mostra tudo
    },

    type: 'ReviewFilterUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-04-22 14:51:26</sys_created_on><sys_id>3282bad78354031027aba6d0deaad313</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ReviewFilterUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Nowflix" source="x_1921407_nowflix">bc71d55e838c4310ad5c9796feaad309</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Nowflix">bc71d55e838c4310ad5c9796feaad309</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_3282bad78354031027aba6d0deaad313</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>nowflix.administrator</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-04-22 14:57:15</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
